headline: Government and BOJ Forex Intervention Hits Record 15.3 Trillion Yen for July–August
summary: Japan's Ministry of Finance said yen-buying, dollar-selling interventions by the government and the Bank of Japan totalled 15.4 trillion yen from July 30 to August 26. The scale exceeded the prior monthly record.
why: Currency intervention by Japanese authorities signals official resistance to yen weakness and affects dollar-yen trading, Japanese exporters and importers, and the cost of holding yen-denominated assets.
why_moved: Record yen-buying intervention by the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Japan points to direct official action in the currency market, which tends to push the yen higher against the dollar.
